data.mechanism: parsers/workflow.py registers model subcommand show only; model_cmds.py has model_show only.

The same check never opens the task record the bug names as the other source of the promise.

chunk_findings.detail: D-DRV-6 is still labeled DECIDED after an in-place cut from `model show|lint|probe|resolve` to `model show` only, with no override note of the kind D-DRV-8 uses in the same table. chunk_findings.detail: The stated fix for B4ba4673c0a is that a unit_tests run whose tree only moved by event-log commits must be recorded against the ran-on sha (or those moves ignored), and the failing-test output kept. The manifest changes only `_found_text` and a string assertion. Given main advanced solely by events commits while the gate ran on sha X and failed, the supersede path is untouched, so the result is still dropped as superseded; appending ids to the “was not recorded” sentence does not record the gate.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/api/gates/_run.py:_found_text

chunk_findings.detail: The regression never builds an events-only main move or a superseded gate record. It only checks `_found_text("failed", {"summary": ["206 failed"], "failed_tests": [...]})`. That assertion can pass while the bug still discards the run, so it does not lock the promised behavior.
chunk_findings.title: tests/test_phase_gate_superseded.py:test_found_text_names_the_failing_test_ids

chunk_findings.detail: Even the message path drops ids: `ids[:80]` is joined with no remainder. Input `failed_tests` of length 81 yields a string that names only the first 80 and never mentions the 81st, so a 206-failure run still loses most of the ids the bug said must survive a supersede.
